title: End of page: the Join waitlist button leaves with the menu, and the phone logo no longer jumps
problem:
At the end of the page the top bar grows into the dark end panel, and its right side goes wrong for a moment.
Two causes, both in the original site too:
- The Join waitlist button should be gone in the first fifth of the grow (about 50 ms).
- But its own width and padding animations keep running for about 0.6 s.
- So a blurred dark smudge stays on the right, and the language switch (EN) sits about 118 px from the right edge instead of 8 px, then slides over.
- On phones the logo also jumps about 15 px right in one frame when the grow starts, and snaps back when the panel closes.
idea:
Two small style rules on top of today's best build (v8), nothing else:
1. While the bar grows or shrinks, the Join waitlist button turns its own animations off, so its width, padding and fade follow the grow directly, as the gap next to it already does.
2. Phones only: the logo's centre point for its shrink moves smoothly from its left edge (closed) to its middle (open), instead of switching in one frame.
At rest nothing changes. Desktop gets rule 1 (it had the same 0.6 s delay); rule 2 is phone-only.
looksSame:
At rest it is the same picture as today's best build.
- Same: the closed bar, the open panel, and the page after scrolling back up.
- Different on purpose: the first few hundred milliseconds of the grow, and the end of the shrink.
visualDiff:
Grow start: the button leaves in about 50 ms (3-4 frames).
- Its blur and fade go with it, and EN moves to its final place at once.
- Before: a dark blurred button stayed about 0.3 s, and EN slid right for about 0.6 s.
Phones: no 15 px logo jump at the grow start; the logo slides to the middle with the panel. When the panel closes, the logo ends where it started, no snap.
After closing, Join waitlist comes back with the shrink (about 0.6 s) instead of about 1.3 s.

Outside the top bar, the grow frames match today's build.
- Frozen frames: 0-1.0 % of pixels differ, the same as today's build against itself (0-0.9 %, the moving avatar row).
- Fully open: the whole frame matches (only the countdown numbers differ).

risk:
Low: style only, two rules.
- The page's script and the grow animation itself are untouched.
- The button now leaves in about 50 ms, as the site's own numbers say. If that feels too fast, a later design change could slow it.
- Reduced motion: nothing changes (the grow is instant there).
- Not checked on the real iPhone; the Safari check ran in the iOS Simulator.
